ideas.title: Centralised Operations Hub
ideas.summary: Live dashboard tracking business processes end-to-end with traffic-light statuses per step (podcast, launches, onboarding, content, member management). A place where you can see what's happening across the whole business at a glance.

ideas.title: Higgsfield for Video Content
ideas.summary: Explore Higgsfield AI for short-form video content (Reels, ads, workshop promos, podcast teasers). 15+ cinematic AI models, $15/mo. Photo-to-video for Tracy's stills. Could slot into the podcast pipeline as asset #16.

ideas.title: FRESH Reset Challenge
ideas.summary: A structured challenge like 75 Hard but designed for women entrepreneurs. Hits every F.R.E.S.H pillar daily. Individualised minimums/maximums, not punishment. Could be standalone product or FFB module.

ideas.title: Webinar / Workshop Stack with Dynamic Sales Page
ideas.summary: Opt-in page → TY page → email-gated replay (48-72h) → dynamic sales page that reshapes to the individual's journey (personalised content + journey-aware + live data). The dynamic piece is the interesting part, Karl's four interpretations captured in the vault.

ideas.title: Learning-Style-Adaptive Sales Pages
ideas.summary: A widget on the sales page that swaps between text-heavy / visual / interactive modes based on how the visitor wants to consume.
ideas.status: research verdict, don't build. Premise is scientifically debunked (Pashler 2008, Kirschner 2017, d ≈ .04). Zero comparable case studies. Build TL;DR + hybrid multi-format single page + quiz-driven personalisation instead. Full report at opencore-vault/Brain/Research/Learning-style-sales-pages-2026-04-19.md
